description: Statement write decision compiled to the neural ISA: role-filler pairs (fillers and one-hot role selectors) are bound with core.reasoner.roles and bundled; an active slot of memory.relations.slots with the same polarity and role count and sim >= K - margin is a duplicate; the statement is stored (row and metadata row output, zero otherwise) only when its subject resolved and it is not a duplicate; the discourse state is updated (decay * state + subject) when the subject resolved. dim, match_margin, pronoun_decay equal model/specs/reasoning.json; meta columns as in zerolm-reasoner field.
